headline: Public hearing on continued case at 389 Water St and new petition to redevelop 539-557 Common St into multifamily commercial mixed use.
summary: The board will continue review of 389 Water St (Suenos Basketball) and hold a new hearing on a petition by AYJ Common St LLC to redevelop 539-557 Common St into multifamily commercial mixed use, requiring variances and a special permit.
items: New case: Petition of AYJ Common St LLC, 2 Pine Tree Dr, Methuen MA, requesting Variances under sections 29-16 & 29-18, and a Special Permit under 29-13(f) & 29-23(g)(y) of the Revised Zoning Ordinance, to redevelop 539-557 Common St (lots 145-0-15, 145-0-16, & 145-0-7) in a B-2 Zoning District into multifamily commercial mixed use
location: Lawrence Municipal Conference Room - 255 Essex Street Lawrence, MA
